release_notes: DubCheck now measures the numbers the audiobook platforms actually reject for. RMS level in dBFS, sample peak and the noise floor of your pauses are new checks, so an ACX run is no longer just sample rate, bit depth and mono: it holds your file against the -23 to -18 dBFS RMS window, the -3 dBFS peak ceiling and the -60 dBFS noise floor. Storytel and Spotify Audiobooks carry their own windows. A file with no pause long enough to measure room tone in says so instead of guessing a number. Everything else is unchanged: free for one file per run, every spec profile, full signed PDF, no key and no expiry.
